g.text: I am currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering at UNILASALLE, in Canoas,
building a solid foundation in software engineering, algorithms, programming and software
Alongside my studies, I develop and maintain game modifications that improve performance,
graphics, compatibility and the overall player experience. I also build Helyx, a personal
desktop app created solo from scratch. My work combines software development, reverse
engineering, engine configuration, automation, installer development, technical documentation
These projects also helped define the direction I want to follow professionally: the games
industry, combining technical knowledge with narrative, creative direction, production and a
